disease_state.evidence: In this study we profiled the urinary EV proteome of 8 healthy individuals over 6 months at 9 timepoints (total 72 samples) using DIA-MS.

material_type.evidence: Urinary extracellular vesicles (EVs) are an attractive source for the detection of disease biomarkers.

sample_source.evidence: Urine was collected after a signed informed consent was obtained from each participant.

sex.evidence: For library generation for DIA-measurement, aliquots were taken from all samples to make two pools, one consisting of samples from males and one from females that were used as input for EV isolation.
